concept.reason: Original fossil images and both primary reconstruction figures directly cover required dedicated crest review; no extra concept image.

scope: Complete hadrosaur with modern expanded tall cranial crest, dedicated2013/2020 form review, full trunk, four limbs and long tail. Never obsolete unicorn rod or skull-only object.

scientific_limits.en: Crest reconstruction synthesizes multiple fragmentary specimens, not a complete preserved crest. Follow Zhang etal2020 Fig4 expanded crest with more rostrally inclined nasal and near-horizontal rear skull roof; white areas are reconstructed. CT shows nasal spine itself solid/sandwich-like, not a hollow pipe; this does not disprove the larger hollow crest. Body mount is composite and historically posed, with obsolete rod crest and pronated hands not adopted.12m is NHM genus estimate, not measured photographed skeleton. Soft tissue, colour and posture inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 头冠整合多个零碎标本，不是保存完整头冠。采用Zhang等2020图4较向前倾鼻突和较水平后头顶的扩展高冠，白色缺失部位为复原。CT说明鼻突骨本身为实心夹层而非空管，不等于否定整体中空头冠。躯体装架为合成及历史姿势，旧棒冠和旋前手不采用。12米为NHM属估，非照片骨架实测。软组织、颜色及站姿为推定。

scale.basis: NHM genus estimate; not measured IVPP individual or modern reconstructed crest.

diagnostic_targets: Tall expanded lobate cranial crest with broad rounded summit and continuous connection toward snout, not solitary thin unicorn spike.
Follow2020Fig4: slightly rostrally inclined nasal support and subhorizontal caudal skull roof, not2013 posterior tilt.
Crest narrow across head in frontal view but broad in lateral view; not Corythosaurus round helmet or Parasaurolophus long back tube.
Duckbill, deep hadrosaur trunk, substantial hindlimbs, shorter forelimbs and long tapering tail.
Palms inward/functional supported forefeet without historical splayed pronated grasping hands.
specimen_basis: Actually viewed2013Fig2 IVPPV725/V829 fossil photographs andFig7 reconstructed skull;2020Fig4 revised interpretation;2008Captmondo museum composite mount for torso/limb context only.
acceptance_checks: Dedicated originalgate: modern expanded tall crest compared against2013Fig2/7 and2020Fig4; no obsolete unicorn-like restoration.
Same side/front standard views must show tall lobate lateral outline with narrower transverse profile; distinguish from round helmet and rearward tube without pose/scale trick.
Reviewer explicitly notes2020 more rostral nasal angle and unchanged broadly expandedcrest interpretation, not hollow rod claim.
Complete whole organism with four limbs and longtail; no copy of obsolete mount hands/pose.
Four views only, scientific uncertainty and12m estimate disclosed.
